purpose: Preserve pre-existing implementation plans byte-for-byte while recording the repository-memory reuse assessment required after activation of the CEW reuse-first gate.

plans.rationale: The benchmark was already executed and qualified before repository-memory activation. Its architecture explicitly used a thin CEW adapter around an external replaceable BIM engine and reused IfcOpenShell rather than implementing a BIM/IFC engine internally. No retroactive rewrite of the historical plan is required.

The adoption plan was already executed before repository-memory activation and preserved the replaceable-engine boundary, build123d geometry role, IfcOpenShell IFC role, and existing CEW-B01 human/source-binding gate. The original plan remains historical evidence.
